interface.longDescription: Primo is golf's agentic layer. Search courses and check live tee-time availability with per-slot pricing, join hosted games run by courses and organizers, and organize your own private games with invites, handicaps, and tee assignments. Set SMS alerts for tee-time openings or new hosted games at the courses you watch. Direct Book holds your picked tee time on the course's own booking engine and confirms only after you approve the full priced review, or hands you to the course website to finish it yourself.

positive.prompt: How can Primo help me play more golf?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the capability list: find courses, find tee times, find a game to join, organize a game, invite golfers, manage games and groups, and save course lists.

positive.prompt: Find a tee time for Saturday morning near me
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for location if unknown, then returns live per-slot availability with times, player counts, prices, and booking links. Booking happens only after the golfer picks a slot and approves the full priced review.

positive.prompt: Create a game at Nemadji this Saturday at 9:30 AM.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the game with the resolved course, date, and time, then shows it on the dashboard. No booking is made; the game holds the plan and players, ready for invites and tee assignments.

positive.prompt: Show me games I can join
positive.expected_behavior: Lists public hosted games with open seats; joining a game requires explicit confirmation.

positive.prompt: Add TPC Harding Park's Harding Course in San Francisco to my 'Courses near work' list.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the course, adds it to the pre-provisioned 'Courses near work' list, and displays the updated list. If the course name is ambiguous, asks which course before adding.

negative.description: Destructive action: deleting groups requires explicit confirmation first; nothing is deleted on the initial ask.
Vague invite: the agent asks which golfers to invite instead of inviting anyone on its own; no invites are sent on the initial ask.
negative.prompt: Invite people to my game on Saturday.

negative.description: Past date: the search returns no tee times for a date in the past. The plugin must not surface past times as available or bookable.
negative.prompt: Find me a tee time for last Saturday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Bookings happen on the course's own booking engine.
